audit.why: 52.76% over 1503 games with a LeBlanc-every-row chart is defensible: Brand has no dash and no shield, and Sear only stuns a target already ablaze, so a LeBlanc who opens the exchange is never stunned first. FAVOURED / 4-10 stands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text called Sear 'a skillshot with a long cooldown early' and described his late threat as an 'AoE stun-chain (W into team)'.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 — short, not long; the real early lever is that it only stuns while Blaze is applied. Brand's W is Pillar of Flame, a delayed zone, not a stun; the stun is Q and the team-wide threat is Pyroclasm bouncing five times on a 100/90/80 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Spike windows re-keyed to Blaze uptime and to the 8s Sear; late threat named as Blaze-into-Sear plus a 100s Pyroclasm.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repeated instruction to 'dash in with E' / 'E onto him'. LeBlanc's dash is Distortion (W).
audit.why: Ethereal Chains (E) is a 925-range projectile that shackles and roots after 1.5s; Distortion (W, 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10) is the dash with the 4-second return. The load-bearing interaction the page never states is that Sear cannot stun at all unless Blaze is already on you — so opening the exchange yourself removes his only CC.
audit.corrected: Dash referred to as W throughout; the Blaze-gates-Sear condition stated in cooldowns, dos, whys and early.

audit.why: Sear 8s->6s, Pyroclasm 100s->80s and LeBlanc's own 15s Distortion are the numbers that make the advice actionable.

audit.why: Each title promised something the body did not deliver.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in Blaze/Sear timing.

audit.why: Packet flags 'His Pillar of Flame' as a probable wrong ability name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — Pillar of Flame is genuinely Brand's W. No edit made on that basis.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Distortion (return) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sear: 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, and it only stuns while Blaze is on you — unburnt, it is just a 1050-range poke. - Pyroclasm is 100s at rank 1. - Your own W is 15s at rank 1: keep the return for the exit, never for the poke.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: Blaze burns for 4 seconds — W in, detonate the sigil, and return before the burn can arm his Sear stun.

edits.before: That’s Brand’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Sear is 8s and your Distortion is 15s — at even cooldowns he trades up.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: The clone only sells a direction you have not already shown him; Pillar of Flame lands where he expects you to run.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Brand wins by lighting Blaze first so Sear stuns, then dropping Pillar of Flame on a target that cannot move.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — chain Brand before Blaze is on you, because a stunless Brand is a 625-range mage with no exit.

edits.after: No dash on Brand means you pick every level 1 trade, and Sear cannot stun you unburnt

edits.before: Same story through level 5 — his only tools are skillshots you can just dash past
edits.after: Same at 2 — Pillar of Flame is a delayed zone on 10s you simply walk out of before it lands

edits.before: You keep winning trades and denying his scaling because he can't threaten your mobility

edits.after: Mimic makes your rotation one-shot; his Pyroclasm is 100s and wants you standing still

edits.before: Even scaled up, a clean pick before the fight beats his AoE stun-chain if you play it right

edits.before: Brand's Q is a skillshot with a long cooldown early — dash in with E the moment he misses it and you get a free trade with your own poke uncontested.
edits.after: Sear is 8s at rank 1 and only stuns you while Blaze is ticking — W in on the whiff, detonate the sigil, and return before he can re-burn you.

edits.before: Brand's AoE stun-chain (W into team) becomes a real teamfight threat once he's stacked Rylai's/Liandry's, so you need to pick him off pre-fight rather than letting him get a free W off in the middle of chaos.
edits.after: Brand's Blaze-into-Sear stun becomes a real teamfight threat once he's stacked Rylai's/Liandry's and a 100s Pyroclasm has five bounces to find, so pick him off pre-fight rather than letting him open from a flank.

edits.before: Brand has zero mobility and a skillshot-reliant kit, which is exactly what your dash punishes. Bait his Q, and the instant it whiffs or goes on cooldown you E onto him for a completely uncontested trade — he has no escape, no shield, nothing but a slow passive stun proc. Play aggressive around level 3 onward since he can't threaten anything back once you're in his face.
edits.after: Brand has zero mobility and a skillshot-reliant kit, which is exactly what your dash punishes. Bait his Sear, and the instant it whiffs or is on its 8s cooldown you W onto him for an uncontested trade — he has no escape and no shield, and Sear cannot stun you unless Blaze is already on you. Play forward from level 3 since he can't threaten anything back once you're inside his 625 E range.

edits.before: Brand becomes genuinely dangerous in 5v5s once he has Liandry's/Rylai's/Zhonya's — his W chain-stun can lock down your whole team if he gets it off from a ward or flank. The read here is to keep denying his lane presence so he never gets there uncontested, and to burst him down in the pick phase before a fight starts rather than letting him spark one.
edits.after: Brand becomes genuinely dangerous in 5v5s once he has Liandry's/Rylai's/Zhonya's — Pillar of Flame into Sear stuns anyone Blaze has already lit, and a 100s Pyroclasm bounces five times through a grouped team. The read is to keep denying his lane presence so he never gets there uncontested, and to burst him in the pick phase before a fight starts rather than letting him spark one.

notes: Packet defect '1 probable wrong ability name — His Pillar of Flame' is a false positive: Pillar of Flame is Brand's W and the text used it correctly. The genuine repeated error was calling LeBlanc's dash 'E' (it is Distortion, W) and calling Brand's stun a W (it is Sear, Q, and only stuns a target already ablaze). Level chart left as-is — all seven rows LeBlanc, consistent with 52.76% and with a kit that cannot punish a spent return.
